deadly_aspects.name: Deadly Aspects
deadly_aspects.text: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a {0}% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by {1}% for {2} sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a {3}% chance of increasing melee attack speed by {4}% for {5} sec.

endurance_training.name: Endurance Training
endurance_training.text: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by {0}%.

focused_fire.name: Focused Fire
focused_fire.text: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by {0}% while your pet is active.

improved_aspect_of_the_monkey.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
improved_aspect_of_the_monkey.text: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by {0}%. Additionally, your pet gains {1}% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

pathfinding.name: Pathfinding
pathfinding.text: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by {0}%.

improved_revive_pet.name: Improved Revive Pet
improved_revive_pet.text: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by {0} sec, mana cost is reduced by {1}%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional {2}%.

bestial_swiftness.name: Bestial Swiftness
bestial_swiftness.text: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

unleashed_fury.name: Unleashed Fury
unleashed_fury.text: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by {0}%.

improved_mend_pet.name: Improved Mend Pet
improved_mend_pet.text: Gives your Mend Pet spell a {0}% chance of cleansing {1} Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by {2}%.

ferocity.name: Ferocity
ferocity.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by {0}%.

summon_hawk.name: Summon Hawk
summon_hawk.text: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 32 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

spirit_bond.name: Spirit Bond
spirit_bond.text: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate {0}% of total health every {1} sec.

intimidation.name: Intimidation
intimidation.text: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

bestial_discipline.name: Bestial Discipline
bestial_discipline.text: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by {0}% and allows {1}% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.text: Gives your pet a {0}% chance to gain a {1}% attack speed increase for {2} sec after dealing a critical strike.

bestial_wrath.name: Bestial Wrath
bestial_wrath.text: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

hawk_eye.name: Hawk Eye
hawk_eye.text: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by {0} yards.

improved_concussive_shot.name: Improved Concussive Shot
improved_concussive_shot.text: Gives your Concussive Shot a {0}% chance to stun the target for {1} sec.

lethal_attacks.name: Lethal Attacks
lethal_attacks.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by {0}%.

improved_stings.name: Improved Stings
improved_stings.text: Increased the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by {0}%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by {1} sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by {2} sec.

efficiency.name: Efficiency
efficiency.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by {0}%.

careful_aim.name: Careful Aim
careful_aim.text: Increases your Attack Power by {0}% of your Intellect.

rapid_killing.name: Rapid Killing
rapid_killing.text: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by {0} min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within {1} sec by {2}%.

improved_arcane_shot.name: Improved Arcane Shot
improved_arcane_shot.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by {0} sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

lone_wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone_wolf.text: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

trueshot_aura.name: Trueshot Aura
trueshot_aura.text: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 30. Lasts 30 min.

mortal_shots.name: Mortal Shots
mortal_shots.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by {0}%.

rapid_recuperation.name: Rapid Recuperation
rapid_recuperation.text: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you {0}% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you {1}% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next {2} sec.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.text: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by {0}%.

scatter_shot.name: Scatter Shot
scatter_shot.text: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

ranged_weapon_specialization.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
ranged_weapon_specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by {0}%.

sniper_shot.name: Sniper Shot
sniper_shot.text: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 160.

improved_tracking.name: Improved Tracking
improved_tracking.text: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by {0}%.

entrapment.name: Entrapment
entrapment.text: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for {0} sec.

savage_strikes.name: Savage Strikes
savage_strikes.text: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by {0}%.

improved_wing_clip.name: Improved Wing Clip
improved_wing_clip.text: Gives your Wing Clip ability a {0}% chance to immobilize the target for {1} sec.

clever_traps.name: Clever Traps
clever_traps.text: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by {0}% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by {1}%.

surefooted.name: Surefooted
surefooted.text: Increases your hit chance by {0}% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by {1}%.

deterrence.name: Deterrence
deterrence.text: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

survival_tactics.name: Survival Tactics
survival_tactics.text: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by {0}%.

predator_s_edge.name: Predator's Edge
predator_s_edge.text: Increases your melee critical strike damage by {0}% and your offhand weapon damage by {1}%.

counterattack.name: Counterattack
counterattack.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

resourcefulness.name: Resourcefulness
resourcefulness.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by {0}%. In addition, your critical strikes have a {1}% chance to allow {2}% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for {3} sec.

expose_prey.name: Expose Prey
expose_prey.text: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a {0}% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for {1} sec.

survivalist_s_discipline.name: Survivalist's Discipline
survivalist_s_discipline.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by {0}%.

strider_kick.name: Strider Kick
strider_kick.text: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.

lacerating_strikes.name: Lacerating Strikes
lacerating_strikes.text: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage over 21 sec equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite.
